_comment: Minimal override of Vercel's zero-config Python detection. Reason: the /api/brief and /api/analyze endpoints fan out to several external APIs (Yahoo Finance, NewsAPI, Bayse) in parallel and then make sequential Groq LLM calls. The default function duration (10s on Hobby / 15s on Pro) can be exceeded on a cold path, so we raise maxDuration to 60s. Everything else — FastAPI detection, Python runtime pinning via .python-version, dependency install from requirements.txt — is left to Vercel's zero-config behavior.
